# DEC-01: Email purchase orders first

## Context
The Build Plan has to start with one kind of order; purchase orders arrive by email and by phone (logs/larkspur-ceramics/meetings/MTG-01/notes.md#D1).

## Options
- Email purchase orders first: most of the volume, and they already arrive as files.
- Email and phone orders together: covers everything, but phone orders have no file to work from.

## Decision
Purchase orders that arrive by email come first; phone orders stay on the order sheet for now.
